about: Lines of code (js, mjs, ts, css, html, py) per area, with ~3% slack: tools/budgets.ts. An area over its budget fails lint; raise a budget only with a new reason describing its current contents and size.

..reason: The root holds the server entry point and the Vite, Vitest and Playwright configurations.

fleet-box.reason: The boxed checker validates generated looks against the library, rig, module chains and light settings.

pi.reason: The Pi includes request-matched queue acknowledgements, reload polling and startup-race regressions, with a shared safety-case runner and injected-clock socket tests alongside safe output lifecycle, guard timing, fades and control-page coverage.

public.reason: The app and sandbox HTML shells load their browser entry points.

public/css.reason: Styles cover the app shell, Studio panels, timeline, live controls, admin pages (the Pi bundle's too) and phone layouts.

public/js.reason: Browser code includes the pattern core, sandbox, viewers and the Studio, live, admin and tutorial interfaces.

public/patterns.reason: The built-in library provides sources, warps and filters as short standalone pattern modules.

render-box.reason: The render box prepares looks and renders deterministic frames to FSEQ under its resource limits.

shared.reason: Shared schemas and pure rules define looks, generated compositions, API data, permissions and playback.

src.reason: The server implements authentication, storage, generation, baking, frames and live administration, including bounded request-matched Pi queue acceptance, current bake verification and ordered verification timestamps when the host wall clock steps back.

test.reason: Unit, integration and browser suites cover Pi queue refusal, concurrent acknowledgements and unknown outcomes, deterministic generator barriers, bake-restore wall-clock rollback, complete-line relay telemetry and store cleanup before fixture removal, alongside existing bake, editor, Pi feed, installer and API regressions.

tools.reason: Tools build and check rig and palette data, check the Pi bundle holds nothing secret, enforce budgets, support development and backups, and benchmark rendering.
